from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys
p=Path.cwd(); r=json.loads((p/'reservation.json').read_text()); assert hashlib.sha256((p/'reservation.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()=='097bb8197f8fbf2688fc95e278bcf32283bc42bcbb37b30496c93a2ef96c03c5'

for f in sorted(base.glob('mathdb-normalized-chunk-*.jsonl')):
 data=f.read_bytes(); ch=hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()
 for i,b in enumerate(data.splitlines(keepends=True),1):
